title: Comunicado 2026-06-16
summary: The Consejo unanimously held the TPM at 4.5% and kept the meeting-by-meeting guidance, but the risk assessment shifted: the balance of risks to inflation is now judged to be 'equilibrating', as the oil-driven rise in headline (3.9% in May) has followed historical pass-through patterns, core is stable at 3.2% and two-year expectations sit at the 3% target. The US-Iran ceasefire and the drop in oil below US$80 are welcomed but treated with caution given the conflict's back-and-forth, while domestic activity contracted in Q1, unemployment rose and several determinants of household consumption weakened. Versus the April communique, which stressed a war more adverse than the IPoM scenario, higher short-term inflation projections and particular attention to factors that could amplify pass-through or persistence, the text drops the upside-risk emphasis and adds softer activity and labor signals. Net, it moves from a hold with upside-risk vigilance to a balanced, data-dependent hold with no easing signal.

key_quotes.quote: El Consejo estima que el balance de riesgos para la inflación se ha ido equilibrando, aunque el escenario macroeconómico sigue sujeto a un grado de incertidumbre mayor al habitual.
key_quotes.context: Risk balance moves from upside-tilted (April) to equilibrating

key_quotes.quote: La inflación subyacente —IPC sin volátiles— no ha mostrado mayores cambios en los últimos meses (3,2% anual a mayo), reflejando un traspaso del shock de costos similar a patrones históricos.
key_quotes.context: Oil shock pass-through contained; core stable

key_quotes.quote: En el mercado laboral, se observa un aumento de la tasa de desempleo, en un contexto de débil creación de empleo.
key_quotes.context: Labor market weakening, new versus April's unchanged unemployment

key_quotes.quote: De este modo, la evolución futura de la TPM irá evaluándose Reunión a Reunión en función del desarrollo de los acontecimientos.
key_quotes.context: Guidance unchanged: meeting-by-meeting, no directional signal
